angle_convention: query to target; positive clockwise in image x-right/y-down coordinates
coarse_match: target first iteration offset from fused final point vs inverse-rotated offset in current segment query frame
sampling: deterministic evenly spaced query indices, no feature/label-based selection; every nonquery frame
reencode: raw query patch inverse-warp resampling then unchanged CoTracker fnet; target zero-angle patch same size; center held out from coarse offset search
evaluation: Observation only: no position/V/C/memory feedback, no four-way probes. Crop/zero-angle effects separated. Public test previously inspected, supplementary analysis only.
